item.title: Core Concepts
item.description: Core Concepts This page introduces the key concepts you’ll use throughout Gorai development. The Object Model - Explained Simply Think of Gorai like building with LEGO blocks for robots. Every single piece in the system—whether it’s a camera, a motor, an AI vision system, or a communication channel—is built from the same fundamental building block called a Resource.
